faq.question: Q1. What is GGU Control Systems & Circuit Design Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification issued by Guru Ghasidas Vishwavidyalaya, Bilaspur for hiring one project staff member under a MeitY-funded Centre of Excellence project.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Control Systems & Circuit Design Engineer post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications via email is 12 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the essential educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a B.E./B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering, Electronics Engineering or MSc in Computer Science (CS) / Information Technology (IT) or related discipline with 55% marks from a recognized University or Institute.

faq.question: Q5. Is experience mandatory for this post?
faq.answer: Yes, a minimum of 2 years of experience in Control Systems, Circuit Design, startups, academic or industry projects is required.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The age limit is 45 years.

faq.question: Q7. What is the consolidated salary offered?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 30,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for this position?
faq.answer: Candidates must send their detailed CV, self-attested educational documents, experience certificates, and publication list via email to [email protected] by 12 October 2026.

faq.question: Q9. When and where will the interview take place?
faq.answer: The interview will be held on 16 October 2026 at 10:00 AM onwards at the GGV TEC Centre, Old Forestry Building, Guru Ghasidas Vishwavidyalaya, Bilaspur (C.G.).

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the appointment is purely temporary, contractual, and co-terminus with the project for a duration of 2 years.
